name: Shizuka
source:
The young and only heir of a very important and powerful company runned by her father. Shizuka started to notice some strange behaviors on her family when The Corporation approached to work with them. Owner of the Red Clover. Shizuka, despite of being only 20 years old, is ready to show the world that she’s not a little girl anymore, and she's capable of not only saving her family’s company, but the world by using her powerful attitude.
